campaign.title: Complete regular beta finite-part symbol BV

resource_policy.literature_policy: Use exact differentiation, divided differences, Mellin/gamma symbol estimates, and BV product rules. Search primary literature only if a named uniform Mellin-symbol or finite-Hilbert divided-difference theorem materially shortens the proof; audit moving-endpoint, cutoff, and parameter-uniformity hypotheses before use.

frozen_target.question: Does the complete regular finite part, after removing the explicit delta jumps and q^(-4) face logarithms, satisfy the scale-normalized BV norm needed to retain the local q^(-2) beta gain through every actual profile and residue seam?
frozen_target.reference_formula: For each signed saddle with lambda=pi q sqrt(Xx)/D_j, expand the exact regular finite part from Delta_H(L,mu)=[H(L,L-mu)-H(L,L)]/mu inside the artificial-pole-safe combination omega G+(1-omega)R1-omega E1. Prove ||B||_infinity+||partial_y B||_1 << X^epsilon D_j/(q lambda) times the exact inherited h,D_j,x monomial in the exact Morse variable y, with endpoint traces and summable height tails.
quantities: divided difference Delta_H and its L derivative
omega G/R1/E1 derivative cancellation at rho=0
v=0 axial and b downarrow zero loss
actual dyadic profiles, floors, stars, and radial factors
finite U,V,S height tails and q^(-2) normalization

completion_criteria: The complete regular finite-part amplitude is written explicitly before differentiation.
Every derivative term and moving endpoint trace is bounded at the target scale or the first exact offender is isolated.
The omega-prime cancellation is checked with identical masks, domains, and endpoints.
The q^(-2), h, scale, radial, profile, floor, star, and external normalization ledgers are preserved.
Finite U,V,S tails and the b downarrow zero limit are proved summable or isolated as the next survivor.
A blind rederivation and hostile audit independently assess the result.
The conductor closes the round before choosing the next objective.

tasks.target: From the accepted Round-27 and Round-30 statements only, independently reconstruct the exact complete regular finite-part amplitude and a term-by-term Morse-variable derivative ledger. Prove the target BV norm or identify the first factor whose derivative exceeds it. Do not use any Round-31 claimant report.
required_output: Exact complete-symbol definition and derivative ledger
Target BV proof or first exact offending factor
Seven-section report at the assigned path

tasks.target: Expand the complete omega-recombined regular finite part, apply divided-difference and BV product estimates to every actual factor, and prove the scale-normalized symbol norm with endpoint traces and summable tails. required_output: Complete regular-symbol BV proof or smallest explicit offender
Derivative, endpoint, q-power, tail, and normalization ledger
